2608.20807.title: Neuro-Geospatial Modelling of EEG Affective States Using Literature-Informed Environmental Context
2608.20807.paper_summary: Environmental exposures such as air pollution and greenness have been associated with affective and cognitive outcomes, but EEG and environmental datasets are rarely jointly georeferenced. We investigate whether literature-informed environmental priors can serve as an auxiliary geospatial modality for EEG-based affective-state classification when individual-level exposure data are unavailable. We combine 30-channel EEG from the EAV benchmark (42 participants, aged 20-30 years) with environmental representations derived from OpenAQ, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-5P, and OpenStreetMap data for Astana. A dual-tower architecture combines EEG-Conformer representations with a graph-based environmental encoder. Because the datasets are not co-registered, environmental context is treated as a literature-informed prior rather than measured exposure. Subject-level repeated splits, permutation and label-shuffling controls, dose-response reversal, and domain-shift experiments distinguish architecture-level gains from prior-dependent gains. The multimodal model achieves 76.2% accuracy versus 67.4% for EEG alone. Controls disrupting environmental-label structure retain part of this gain, indicating that the improvement is not attributable solely to environmental information. Replacing the Astana environmental distribution with an independently modeled Singapore distribution reduces accuracy to 72.8%. These findings demonstrate technical feasibility but do not establish an observed or causal exposure-affect association. The study provides a framework for future jointly collected mobile EEG-environment studies. Implementation: https://github.com/r11up/geo-cog
2608.20807.paper_summary_zh: 環境暴露，例如空氣污染和綠地，已與情感和認知結果相關聯，但 EEG 和環境數據集很少共同地理參考。我們研究文獻知識的環境先驗是否可以作為 EEG 基於情感狀態分類的輔助地理空間模式，當個體層級的暴露數據不可用時。我們將來自 EAV 基準的 30 通道 EEG（42 名參與者，年齡 20-30 歲）與來自 OpenAQ、Sentinel-2、Sentinel-5P 和 OpenStreetMap 數據的阿斯塔納環境表示結合起來。雙塔架構將 EEG-Conformer 表示與基於圖形的環境編碼器相結合。由於數據集未共同註冊，環境上下文被視為文獻知識的先驗，而不是測量的暴露。主體層級的重複分割、置換和標籤隨機控制、劑量反應反轉和領域轉移實驗區分了架構層級的增益與依賴於先驗的增益。多模態模型達到 76.2% 的準確率，而僅使用 EEG 的準確率為 67.4%。破壞環境標籤結構的控制保留了部分增益，這表明改善並不僅僅歸因於環境信息。將阿斯塔納的環境分佈替換為獨立建模的新加坡分佈會將準確率降低至 72.8%。這些發現顯示了技術的可行性，但並未建立觀察到的或因果的暴露-情感關聯。該研究為未來共同收集的移動 EEG-環境研究提供了一個框架。實施：https://github.com/r11up/geo-cog
